blocks.caption: A caption long enough to wrap in the table's header, to show how Slack lays it out

rows.text: This sentence is here to make the text long enough to wrap onto several lines at the desktop width, and further still on a phone, so the wrapping, the line height and any truncation Slack applies all show. It goes on a little longer, past three hundred characters, which is where long text starts to behave differently.
